Did you know that we offer both home and car window tinting in Canberra? Below we list the types of films we use for home and car tinting.

Tint a Car is Australia’s most trusted tinting network for car, home and office window tinting. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years. We use high-quality films that are exclusive to us (supplied by the largest supplier of window film in the world) and are government certified by ARPANSA. All installations are done by professionally trained installers and for car window tinting Canberra, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee, no questions asked.

For home window tinting Canberra and car window tinting, we offer a lifetime warranty on applications. Here are the films we offer for car window tinting and house window tinting in Canberra:

Car Window Tinting Canberra

Film options for car window tinting Canberra include:

  • Octane – our darkest legal tint
  • Spectre – ceramic film technology offering superior infrared rejection
  • High Octane – our darkest legal safety tint up to 4 times thicker than standard film
  • Formula One – for crystal clear views and maximum heat & glare rejection
  • Midnight Express – our value for money window film

Home Window Tinting Canberra

For home window tinting in Canberra, we offer the following films:

  • Solar window films – reduces the amount of heat & glare that enters your home
  • Privacy films – stops those on the outside from seeing into your home during the day but still lets natural light in
  • Safety films – helps to keep you and your family safe from breakages and break-ins
  • Security films – 7 x stronger than standard film
  • Decorative films – adds a unique and stylish element to your home whilst also offering privacy for rooms like bathrooms

Interest-free payment options are available for car and home window tinting through Afterpay and Zip Pay where you can split your purchase over 3, 6, 9, or 12 months with ZERO interest.
